shellWidthContract.measurement: ResizeObserver on the HomeLayout main inline-size
shellWidthContract.navigationOwnership: HomeLayout renders the visible desktop navigation and gives the main element the exact remaining inline-size. Classic defaults to the approved 248px expanded navigation; Flow defaults to the approved 64px compact rail. Preferences are isolated by tenant, user, and Home mode. The 390px/320px mobile shell uses a fixed safe-area-aware five-destination bottom navigation. The 600px-1199px compact/tablet shell exposes the same permission-filtered navigation from the header drawer without covering document content.

assertions: visible Home navigation owns the configured mode-specific width
HomeLayout main receives viewport width minus the actual navigation width
navigation preference storage is isolated by Home mode
mobile navigation targets are at least 44px and focused footer content remains above the fixed navigation
the 720px browser-zoom composition uses the keyboard-accessible header drawer with no fixed bottom overlay
Home root remains inside viewport bounds
